acknowledgement: My sole research target is the full universal bounded-density statement for X^T A X with independent coordinate densities bounded by one and at least three eigenvalues of A having absolute value at least one.

latest_substantive_result.scope: Proved a determinant-scale one-sided half-potential bound for every indefinite binary quadratic under arbitrary independent density-capped inputs, and combined it with dependence-safe square completion to bound every physical 3x3 indefinite majority-sign nonzero pivot branch by 8/|c det B|^(1/4).

first_unresolved_implication: Convert determinant-scale physical-triple bounds into a dimension-free bound from only three large spectral eigenvalues; fixed-triple selection can lose dimension.
next_concrete_attempt: Aggregate coordinate pivots and 3x3 minors with determinant/Cauchy-Binet weights inside a small-ball or coarea estimate, preserving the original product law instead of selecting one worst triple.
